meta.title: The Last Days
meta.subtitle: The world has fallen. What you do now decides how your story ends.
meta.historyEmptyText: Your path will be recorded here as you make choices.

scenes.title: ☠️ Day 1
scenes.narrative:
Sirens echo through the city.

Emergency broadcasts repeat the same message: Stay inside.

But outside, chaos has already begun.

People are running. Fires are spreading.

Something is very wrong.

scenes.title: 🔒 Locked In
scenes.narrative:
You lock your doors and shut the blinds.

The TV flickers. Reports mention an outbreak.

Food and supplies are limited.

scenes.title: 🏚️ The Streets
scenes.narrative:
The streets are filled with panic.

You see abandoned cars, broken glass, and something worse.

A figure stumbles toward you… not normal.

scenes.title: 📵 No Answer
scenes.narrative:
You call friends and family.

Most lines are dead.

One call connects… then cuts to static and screaming.

scenes.title: 🛠️ Preparation
scenes.narrative:
You gather food, water, and tools.

You are better prepared… but staying may not be enough.

scenes.title: 👹 First Encounter
scenes.narrative:
The infected lunges at you.

You barely manage to fight it off.

You realize now—this is real.

scenes.title: 🏪 Abandoned Store
scenes.narrative:
You enter a looted store.

Shelves are mostly empty, but you find some supplies.

You hear voices in the back.

scenes.title: 👥 Survivors
scenes.narrative:
A small group of survivors greets you.

They offer safety—but trust is uncertain.

scenes.title: 🚶 Alone
scenes.narrative:
You decide to survive alone.

It’s quieter… but far more dangerous.

scenes.title: 🤝 Traveling Together
scenes.narrative:
You travel with the group.

They talk about a safe zone outside the city.

scenes.title: 💨 Narrow Escape
scenes.narrative:
You escape into an alley.

It’s quiet… too quiet.

scenes.title: 🏢 Rooftop
scenes.narrative:
From above, the city burns.

Helicopters fly overhead—but don’t stop.

scenes.title: 🏠 Safehouse
scenes.narrative:
You find a defensible building.

It’s quiet. Secure.

But supplies won’t last forever.

scenes.title: 🌄 Edge of the City
scenes.narrative:
You reach the outskirts.

The world beyond looks empty… but safer.

scenes.title: ✅ Safe Zone
scenes.narrative:
You reach a guarded checkpoint.

They scan you.

You are allowed in.

scenes.title: 💀 Too Late
scenes.narrative:
You stay inside.

Days pass.

Eventually… something breaks in.

scenes.title: 🚁 Rescue
scenes.narrative:
A helicopter sees you.

You are lifted out.

You survived.

scenes.title: 🪦 Lone Survivor
scenes.narrative:
You survive alone.

It’s not easy.

But you adapt.

You endure.

scenes.title: 🌅 New Beginning
scenes.narrative:
You leave the city behind.

The world is broken—but you are alive.

A new story begins.

scenes.title: ⚡ Overwhelmed
scenes.narrative:
You return to the city.

You are surrounded.

There is no escape.
